objective: Complete the function to count the number of ways to climb n stairs, taking either 1 or 2 steps at a time.

def climb_stairs(n):
    if n <= 2:
        return n
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[1] = 1
    dp[2] = 2
    # Your code here
    return dp[n]
